title: approvals: an expression approver that yields the same user id twice opens two co_sign slots for one person — the slate is not deduped
body:
domain:server#5 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5oc56xChD6Wrc4cGSt

Carries item (c) of #28658; #28658 keeps items (a) and (b), which wait on a maintainer decision (the published contract says a decision output's `type`/`multiple` only shape the input widget). Part of #28658 · in-flight derived sub-card (`execution-duties.md`: in-scope derivative of a claimed card, seat-owned, priority inherited p2, dispatched directly).

## What happens

Measured on #28658 at framework `6e11a929` (stock showcase, `showcase_dynamic_approval`): approving stage 1 with `{"outputs":{"next_reviewers":["ADMIN_ID","ADMIN_ID"]}}` makes stage 2's `co_sign` node open **two** approver slots for the same user. One person then has to sign twice, or a co-sign quorum counts one person as two signatures.

This needs no contract change: the expression approver already accepts "ids (string / CSV / string array)" (`plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts`, the expression branch, about L2715–2760), and nothing published says a slate may name one person twice.

## Wanted

- The approver slate built from an expression approver names each resolved user once (dedupe after resolution, including after out-of-office delegation, so two ids delegated to the same person also yield one slot). Order of first appearance is kept.
- Check whether the static approver kinds and the graph `resolveAs` kinds already dedupe; if one of them has the same hole, fix it at the same seam and name it in the PR, otherwise say they are covered.

## Tests

- Stage 2 opened from `["A","A"]` has one slot for A; `["A","B","A"]` has two slots, A then B.
- Two ids whose OOO delegation routes to the same delegate yield one slot.
- Ablation: remove the dedupe, show red, restore.

## Not here

Refusing an unknown id, a scalar for `multiple: true`, or duplicates at the decision itself: #28658 (a)/(b), pending the decision.

Dedupe: searched `co_sign duplicate approver`, `expression approver dedupe`, `same user twice slot` — no open card.
